0022600165.text: The Memphis Grizzlies, 6-0 and first in the Southwest and the West, host the New Orleans Pelicans, who are 2-4 and 11th in the West, in Memphis' seventh game of the season. Memphis is missing Quinten Post (ankle) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), while New Orleans is without Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting on January 30, 2026 in New Orleans, a 114-106 Grizzlies loss.
